content.text:
I've submitted **index 0 (Fe 0.87, Sb 0.13)** as the best composition, with an EQE of 0.637%. The merit budget is used up (3 of 3). I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which phase is actually present at each composition is inferred, not confirmed.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.13 | **0.637** |
| 4 | 0.20 | 0.294 |
| 14 | 0.48 (close to the FeSbO4 compound) | 0.003 |

- **Trend:** EQE drops steadily as Sb increases, so the best area is the iron-rich end, which should behave like hematite (Fe2O3) with a little Sb added.
- **What the models said:** MACE puts both hematite and FeSbO4 on the stability hull, meaning both should form. MEGNet predicts both absorb the 2.7 eV light. So the poor result near FeSbO4 comes from how well it converts absorbed light into current, not from failing to absorb.
- **What I skipped:** The Gaussian-process tool suggested index 8 as the third measurement. I measured index 0 instead, because index 8 sits between two measured points on a falling trend toward the poor FeSbO4 region.

Index 0 is the most iron-rich composition in the library, so the true peak could not be bracketed. With a larger budget, I'd measure index 1 to check whether EQE really peaks at the lowest Sb level available.
